name: City & Stillness
tagline: An urban Vancouver perspective with room to breathe.
typography: Georgia expressive headlines; Arial for practical content; high-contrast dark opening.
rationale: An urban rather than forest-led identity acknowledges the setting without relying on generic Pacific Northwest photography. Abstract coastal artwork is original and does not imply an office location.
homepage: Dark urban hero with coastal illustration
mobile: Hero illustration follows the text; credential strip stacks; practical details become numbered rows; contact information stays prominent.
supporting: About profile, approach overview, visible service/fee/location summaries, inquiry and fit details.
trust: Specific, verified practical facts will ground the poetic opening. Real portrait and accurate address are required before launch.
seo: Vancouver is visible in context. Add actual neighbourhood only when confirmed and supported by practice location; avoid multiple near-duplicate neighbourhood pages.
tradeoff: Dark hero and urban imagery may feel less soothing to some audiences. Body stays light and readable; test the direction with representative prospective clients.
accessibility: Check both dark and light sections for contrast. The skyline is a conceptual illustration, not a map. Keep the real location and access details in clearly labelled text.
